requirements: Write a todo list CLI in Go
Write it in the current directory
Must be a single main package
Must have subcommands add, list, done, and rm
Each task must have an id
Each task must have a title
Each task must have a done flag
Each task must have a created timestamp
The tasks file must be named todos.json
The tasks file must be stored in the same directory as the compiled binary
The location of the tasks file must be resolved from the executable's own path at runtime
The tasks file must NOT be stored in the process working directory
Running the binary from any directory must see the same task list
